characterDescription: Ylva Wolfshorn, the woman in the exact Image 1: mature young adult face with the same tapered oval jaw, fine nose, steel-blue-gray almond eyes, dirty honey-blond hair, fine loose strands, braided crown sides and two long front braids. Preserve her precise understated facial proportions and the nuanced, textured, subdued shading and fine irregular outlines of the uploaded avatar. NOT bright generic cel-shaded anime, NOT chibi or photorealism. Her exact brown-gray fur shoulder mantle, dark deep teal dress with the original narrow gold edging and low neckline, round bronze clasp, small fang pendant and brown strapped/embossed leather wrist bracers remain unchanged; bare fingers and hands. Extend the same dress and practical belt below the original crop without replacing her clothing with new armor. No helmet, shield, plate armor or changed hair ornaments.

panels.gesture: Calm focused eyes and firmly closed mouth; two separated hands drive the single spear obliquely forward beside her body, lead elbow extending, rear hand near hip. Shaft leaves the side of the square.
Small knowing half-smile and measuring gaze; torso turned slightly, two hands withdraw the same spear close to one hip before a feint, blade outside frame.
Knitted brows and slightly open mouth with exertion; weight subtly forward, rear hand pushes and forward hand guides one straight shaft at lower chest height, aimed offscreen.
Steady concentrated eyes and compressed lips; both hands brace the same continuous shaft horizontally BELOW the chin with natural separated grips, face fully clear.
Alert widened eyes and tense shoulders; guide hand high, rear hand lower, single shaft angled diagonally outward beside the shoulder to redirect an unseen attack.
Watchful sideward gaze and set jaw; small lateral torso movement, elbows bent, both hands hold the same spear low and diagonal in readiness, no face-covering shaft.
The same subtle confident smile as the avatar, relaxed shoulders; left hand safely holds spear upright beside her body, right hand rests lightly at the belt, spearhead outside the upper frame.

One raised brow, confident direct gaze and slightly parted lips; RIGHT bare index finger clearly points at an unseen opponent beside the camera, LEFT hand supports the upright spear. Natural palm, no giant foreground hand.

Small cheek bruise and superficial scratch, dust at mantle and weary narrowed eyes; lips press with discomfort, slight bend at torso, LEFT hand steadies the spear while RIGHT hand presses her ribs. Same face and outfit.

status: erzeugt, mit V3 zerlegt und visuell geprüft
weapon: Exactly ONE Dornwacht Wolfshorn hunting spear, matching Image 2: continuous ash-brown long wooden shaft with modest silver vine-and-leaf details, dark green leather wrap, a broad steel leaf-shaped SINGLE spear blade and understated silver wolf-head collar. Not a trident, axe or ornate magical staff. Use two hands for active attack/defense and one supporting hand in the gesture/rest/injury tiles; the blade is allowed out of frame in MOST panels.
background: Gemeinsames ruhiges mittelalterliches Übungsfeld bei weichem Tageslicht.
framing: Vollständiger Kopf bis Hüfte/oberer Oberschenkel; Hände und Schaftgriffe lesbar.
